coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Expert advice represented by a precision lighthouse lens calmly illuminating the most viable route through several diverging terrain paths.
Scene/backdrop: Layered warm paper topography emerging from a deep slate foreground.
Subject: One compact navy lighthouse lens assembly, three branching paths, and a focused cyan beam landing on one orange destination stone.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; strong crop-safe lens and branching-route silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: trustworthy, clarifying, calm
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no signage, maps, labels, or written markings; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
